messages:
morgan: morning async check-in
- what I did: landed prefetch kernel patch (PR #482), ran microbatch perf (seq=128), saw ~6% p95 improvement
- blockers: KV cache thrash under repeated-prefix workloads; eviction churn high, need slot-steal metric to validate
- today: push tiny eviction heuristic fix, re-run 3x bench, open follow-up PR to add metric + tracing

tk: nice. can you paste the bench command + raw p95 numbers?

morgan: sure — ran:
```
./bench_microbatch --model=llama-7b --seq=128 --iters=500
```
results: p50 12ms, p95 48ms -> after patch p95 45ms; throughput +2.3%

sanjay: i'll review PR #482 this afternoon. quick note: canary showed a 3% error spike at 11:12 UTC tied to rpc timeouts

lina: saw the same. logs show repeated `kv-evict` calls during heavy reuse. i can add a tracepoint around `runtime/kv/evict.go` — want me to push a branch?

morgan: please do. branch name `fix/kv-evict-trace` is fine. i'll hold the rollout until we have 2 consecutive green runs

ci-bot: build succeeded for PR #482 — tests: unit/integration (all green) :white_check_mark:

omar: fyi i'll schedule a 1h smoke today @ 16:00 PT to validate tail under synthetic load. ping me if you want to join

tk: thx. @sanjay @lina if you need me to instrument any dashboards or add an alert for slot-steal > 5 I'll take it on

morgan: thanks all. blocking todo recap:
- lina adds tracepoint + push branch
- morgan push eviction heuristic PR and re-run benches
- sanjay review #482
- omar run smoke + report

end.
